text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while working in the trainer's 
office...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely cannot afford to lose today's 
match...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Taiki Shuttle was all fired up, but she 
wasn't supposed to have any races 
scheduled today.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Today is the decisive battle... no, an 
important day worthy of being called a 
duel.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, you let's go too! I want you to 
see me in all my glory!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taken along by Taiki Shuttle, we arrive 
at—

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
And so, the town rodeo contest begins! 
Let's rodeo~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whooooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Everyone and I have been waiting 
for this day!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howevvver, only one can be the victor...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I can't believe I got thrown off in 
the first five seconds...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Kh, what a grueling battle...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...If only I'd held on for one more 
minute, just one more minute. Then I 
would've gotten that 10kg steak prize...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... I really wanted to eat it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems 10 kg of steak has been put up 
as a prize for this tournament.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm getting nervous.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My family always told me: a true cowgirl 
must master the bucking bronco!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Even if that happens to be a mechanical 
bull...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When I wear this outfit, I'm in 
serious mode!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
On my pride as a cowgirl! I'll show you I 
can tame any wild bull, YES SIR!!

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
All right, next up is entry number nine, 
Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I am Taiki Shuttle! I'm the real deal 
cowgirl!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with powerful strides, Taiki Shuttle 
headed toward the mechanical bullâ

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeeeeee-haaaaaaaaw!! This is real-deal 
cowgirl style!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hahaaa! I AM A WINNER!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
To think she could master that machine... 
The prize steak belongs to her!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Waah! That was amazing, Big Sis!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha♪ To everyone and to Trainer! Thank 
you so much for your support~!!"

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
Here, this is your prize—10 kg of steak! 
Make sure you take it all home, okay?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oooh!! Thank you! I got so caught up in 
the rodeo that I completely forgot!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That was fantastic movement. Both the 
strength to hold on until the end and the 
flexibility to handle sudden shifts.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That is why I must ask for your guidance. 
To reach the heights you stand upon... 
what is required?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's true~...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, you already understand, 
right? ...Please tell them for me!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's your obsession with food.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... Appetite, a hungry spirit... 
...Perhaps I too should have prepared by 
abstaining from steak.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, appetite is everything! For the sake 
of a sizzling steak, I would do 
anything...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, nooo!! That's not it at all! I'm not 
*that* big of a glutton~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Jeez, Trainer! Even I get angry, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Taiki Shuttle taught Oguri Cap 
the tricks to riding a rodeo bull.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My resolve to carry my hometown on my 
shoulders as a cowgirl! That's my power!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... I understand that feeling well. 
Thank you. I must work hard as well.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Oguri-san, nice resolve!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle parted ways with Oguri Cap 
looking thoroughly satisfied.
